label: SuperQode Harness
advertise: superqode — run, inspect, and evaluate versioned coding-agent harnesses
hints: Use SuperQode when the user asks to run, compare, validate, or evaluate a HarnessSpec.
Validate or inspect an unfamiliar HarnessSpec before executing it.
Use --json for machine-readable harness results and report the run_id and session_id.
Do not run superqode auth inside the QM computer; use deployment-managed secret environment variables.
Do not start SuperQode servers inside a task; use the deployment's separately managed A2A service boundary.

approvals.reason: QM deployment credentials must not be replaced from inside the agent computer
Long-lived services must be deployed and authenticated outside an individual QM task
A harness run can execute filesystem and shell tools under its HarnessSpec policy
A worker can claim and execute multiple queued harness tasks
Draining an inbox can execute multiple queued harness tasks
A WorkOrder can execute a multi-step coding workflow
Headless agent execution can use filesystem and shell tools
